content.text:
Start at https://raisingcanes.com/ and complete the following task by navigating within that website.

Add a Box Combo to my bag with Diet Coke as the drink, and a Kids Combo with milk as the drink. Select the store closest to ZIP 10001 for pickup tomorrow at 12:00 PM.

Rules:
- Work entirely in this one browser tab. Do NOT open new tabs.
- Do NOT use a search engine (Google, Bing, etc.) or cached/archived copies (e.g. web.archive.org). Navigate the site itself, starting from https://raisingcanes.com/.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.
